note: Douglas County park near Brandon, northwest of Alexandria, on the strip of land between Devils Lake and Little Chippewa Lake, with two swimming beaches, a fishing pier and a paddling channel between the lakes. Drinking water runs about mid-May to mid-October; call ahead for a stay outside that window. --Claude
summary: County page + ResNexus read: 14 sites (12 back-in RV to 40 ft, 2 tent), $35 RV / $25 tent, 2-night Saturday minimum confirmed, showers, vault toilets, water, Wi-Fi. Not waterfront kept against ResNexus 'Lakeside' tags (thick tree band). Phone missing.
flags: WATERFRONT re-audit lead (operator claim vs stored not waterfront): ResNexus names Campsites #6-#12 'Lakeside'. On imagery the RV loop (centre about 45.9931,-95.5862) has its east sites about 35-60 m from Devils Lake through a dense tree band some 25-40 m deep, with no open ground to the shore; no on-water value is earned. Not waterfront kept; if the reviewer reads ResNexus site photos of 6-12 as showing the lake, lakeview is the most it could be (photos not viewed).
PHONE missing: the county page and the ResNexus header give Douglas County Public Works - Parks, 320-762-2999. Suggest 320-762-2999.
Pin 45.994408,-95.587427 sits on the park road about 165 m northwest of the RV loop's centre (45.9931,-95.5862). Under 250 m; a move to the loop is optional.

Hookups: the county page says only 'sites with electrical hookups'; the stored 50 A (derived from the old note) was not contradicted and is left alone. The ResNexus site text mentions a hose bib at the shower building, not water at the sites.
The 2020 master plan proposes 10 more interior RV sites, a north-parcel tent area and cart-in sites (plans only; nothing written).
